sovereign_country.strategic_role: 连接拉美市场的欧洲商贸桥梁、本地化仓配与数字游民签证

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 10/2010, de 28 de abril, de prevención del blanqueo de capitales y de la financiación del terrorismo (as amended by Ley 7/2021 and subsequent regulations); Royal Decree 304/2014, of 5 May, approving the Statute of the Register of Beneficial Owners (Registro de Beneficiarios Finales).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Valid passport or national identity card
Articles of association or incorporation documents
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary or competent authority in country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of registered address and utility bills

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory PEP, OFAC, UN, EU, and Spanish Guardia Civil sanctions screening; full due diligence on UBOs including source of wealth and funds.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Mercantil Central (RMC) and corresponding local Mercantile Registry
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Official use of Spanish language in Latin script; company names must comply with Spanish orthography and naming conventions
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: 'Banco', 'Caja de Ahorros', 'Crédito', 'Inversión', 'Sociedad de Garantía Recíproca', 'Sociedad de Valores', 'Sociedad de Capital Riesgo' and similar financial institution terms without prior authorization
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, file an administrative appeal (recurso de alzada) before the Registro Mercantil within one month; if denied, judicial appeal (recurso contencioso-administrativo) possible.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible; virtual or registered offices are accepted for SL formations in Spain
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low; standard SL companies rarely face unannounced physical inspections unless red flags arise

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Corporate legal services and incorporation assistance
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notarial fees plus market rate for legal advisory (approximately 1000-1500 EUR)
Fixed statutory tariffs for notarial acts and official apostille fees

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name reservation and initial registry filing fees
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Administrative fees established by Royal Decree

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO registration and AML/CFT compliance setup
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for AML services in Spain

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Royal Legislative Decree 1/2010 approving the Spanish Companies Act (Ley de Sociedades de Capital), including Articles 4, 19-30, 58-62, 210-242, and 279-284; Law 14/2013 on entrepreneurs; and Law 18/2022 on the creation and growth of companies, including the one-euro minimum capital regime for limited liability companies.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: The competent Provincial Mercantile Registry (Registro Mercantil Provincial) for the registered office; the Central Mercantile Registry (Registro Mercantil Central) issues the corporate-name clearance certificate.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Public deed of incorporation (escritura pública de constitución) filed for registration with the competent Provincial Mercantile Registry.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: A Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada may be incorporated with minimum share capital of EUR 1. The capital must be fully subscribed and paid at incorporation. No statutory escrow account is required, although a bank certificate may be used to evidence cash contributions. Until equity reaches EUR 3,000, statutory reserves and creditor-protection rules under Law 18/2022 apply. Contributions in kind require identification and valuation in the deed; contributions of work or services do not constitute share capital.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: The Board resolves that the Company accept and ratify the subscription and full payment of its issued quotas as recorded in the incorporation deed; adopt the registered office at the address stated in that deed; approve the corporate purpose consisting of operating an electronic B2B marketplace and related lawful activities; appoint [Name] as sole director, or confirm the directors appointed in the deed, with authority to represent the Company; authorize applications for the NIF, tax registrations, banking arrangements, and all filings required before the Mercantile Registry and other competent authorities.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Clear and reserve the corporate name
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Central Mercantile Registry (Registro Mercantil Central), online name-certification service
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit up to five proposed names, ensuring the name is distinctive and includes the applicable Spanish corporate designation or abbreviation. Obtain the negative name certificate and reserve the approved name for the statutory validity period. A foreign shareholder must provide legalized and, where necessary, apostilled corporate authority documents and certified Spanish translations.
required_dossiers: Power of attorney, if filed by an agent
Apostilled or legalized foreign shareholder documents, if applicable
Sworn or official Spanish translations, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Replace the rejected name and resubmit. If the certificate contains an error, request correction from the Central Mercantile Registry before execution of the deed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Prepare shareholder, director, and registered-office documentation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Spanish notary selected for execution of the incorporation deed
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the articles of association, corporate purpose, share capital and quota allocation, governance model, registered-office details, director acceptances, and beneficial-owner information. Obtain NIE numbers for relevant non-Spanish individuals and NIF documentation for foreign legal-entity shareholders. Legalize or apostille foreign documents and provide certified Spanish translations where required.
required_dossiers: Shareholder identification or corporate registry extracts
Registered-office title, lease, or availability evidence
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Cure missing legalization, translation, identification, or authority evidence before the notarial appointment. Replace defective powers of attorney or obtain supplemental shareholder ratification.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execute the public deed and fund the capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Spanish Notary Public (Notario) and the selected Spanish credit institution
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute the public deed of incorporation before a Spanish notary. Confirm that all quotas are subscribed and paid. For cash contributions, transfer the capital to the incorporation account if used and obtain a bank certificate, or use the statutory shareholder declaration mechanism permitted for an SL. The notary verifies identity, capacity, powers, corporate purpose, beneficial ownership, and anti-money-laundering information.
required_dossiers: Bank certificate or statutory contribution declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct the draft deed, provide missing evidence, or execute a rectification deed. If the notary refuses authorization, obtain written grounds and cure the identified legal or documentary defect.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain the provisional tax identification number
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Spanish State Tax Administration Agency (Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria, AEAT), Form 036 and electronic tax portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File Form 036 with the executed incorporation deed or authorized copy, corporate name certificate, registered-office details, shareholder and director identification, and beneficial-owner information. Request the provisional NIF and register the applicable economic activity and tax obligations, including corporate income tax and VAT where relevant.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond through the AEAT electronic notification system, submit corrected Form 036, and provide any requested identity, address, ownership, or activity evidence within the stated deadline.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Register the company with the Provincial Mercantile Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Provincial Mercantile Registry (Registro Mercantil Provincial) for the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the authorized public deed electronically through the notary or directly through the permitted registry channel, together with the provisional NIF and required supporting documents. Pay the tariff-based registry and publication charges. Monitor the registry entry and obtain the registration certificate or registry extract.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registrar issues a qualification notice, cure each defect within the applicable period by supplementary deed, corrected filing, or additional evidence. Appeal the qualification to the Directorate-General for Legal Certainty and Public Faith or the competent court where appropriate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain the definitive NIF and complete tax registrations
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After Mercantile Registry registration, file the registered deed and registry evidence with the AEAT to convert the provisional NIF into a definitive NIF. Confirm census registration, VAT status, intra-Community operator status where applicable, economic activity codes, and the registered tax address.
required_dossiers: Registry certificate or updated registry extract
VAT and intra-Community registration information, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct census data through a revised Form 036 and respond to AEAT requests through the electronic notification channel. Reapply for VIES registration if intra-Community operator registration is denied.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Establish governance, accounting, and beneficial-owner records
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Provincial Mercantile Registry, AEAT, and the competent regional or local authority as applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Maintain the shareholder ledger, minutes book, contract register, and beneficial-owner documentation. Legalize mandatory corporate books electronically with the Mercantile Registry within the statutory periods. File annual accounts and required management reports. Implement director conflict controls, related-party approval procedures, and accounting records from commencement of operations.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Rectify defective books or filings electronically, submit supplementary records, and respond to registry or tax authority observations. Late filings may trigger registry closure, penalties, or other statutory consequences.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: No national industrial operating licence is ordinarily required for an electronic B2B marketplace without manufacturing. For any warehouse, fulfillment center, premises, or regulated equipment, the competent authority is the autonomous-community industrial authority and the relevant municipality, typically the regional Industry and Energy Directorate and the local licensing department.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No sector-specific manufacturing permit for the stated platform activity. A physical facility may require a municipal activity or opening licence (licencia de actividad or licencia de apertura), a responsible declaration (declaración responsable), and, where applicable, registration under the applicable regional industrial, storage, fire-safety, or logistics regime.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry for the Ecological Transition and the Demographic Challenge (Ministerio para la Transición Ecológica y el Reto Demográfico), with the competent environmental authority of the relevant autonomous community for most projects
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Generally Exempt or outside EIA scope for a digital marketplace operating without a material industrial facility. A warehouse, logistics installation, construction project, waste activity, or materially polluting operation must be screened under Law 21/2013 on Environmental Assessment and applicable autonomous-community legislation; projects listed in its annexes may require simplified or ordinary EIA.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater, VOC, or process-emission thresholds apply to a purely digital platform. A physical facility must comply with municipal and regional discharge authorizations, Law 7/2022 on waste and contaminated soils, applicable packaging and extended-producer-responsibility rules, air-quality requirements, hazardous-waste controls, and any permit-specific limits. Waste must be segregated, documented, and transferred to authorized operators.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: No separate civil-defense clearance is required for a digital-only operation. Physical premises must satisfy the Spanish Building Code, applicable fire-safety rules including Royal Decree 513/2017, municipal opening or activity requirements, emergency planning, evacuation and fire-protection obligations, and occupational-risk prevention duties under Law 31/1995. Warehouses and installations may require structural-load certification, electrical and fire-system inspections, and legally qualified maintenance records.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT) – State Tax Administration Agency; electronic portal: Sede Electrónica de la AEAT (https://sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a Spanish resident SL, incorporation occurs by notarial deed and registration in the Mercantile Registry; AEAT then issues the definitive NIF via Form 036/declaración censal, and that NIF also constitutes the Spanish VAT number. For a foreign entity without a permanent establishment, the entity must first determine whether it has Spanish tax or VAT exposure; if yes, appoint a fiscal/tax representative where mandatory, submit Form 036 to AEAT to obtain the non-resident NIF, and register in the VAT census. If the entity will perform intra-Community acquisitions or supplies, it must also be recorded in the Registro de Operadores Intracomunitarios (ROI) before engaging in such transactions.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Spain does not provide a check-the-box or hybrid-entity pass-through election; an SL is per se an entity-level corporate income taxpayer. Elective regimes relevant to this business include: consolidated corporate income tax group for Spanish entities with a 75% direct or indirect parent-subsidiary relationship; Spanish VAT group (grupo de IVA) subject to AEAT authorization; patent box reduced taxation; ETVE holding-company regime; accelerated depreciation and investment-book incentive elections; and for indirect tax, the Union/non-Union one-stop-shop (OSS), Import one-stop-shop (IOSS), and simplified/modules or flat-rate agricultural VAT schemes. Anti-hybrid rules under Law 27/2014 and ATAD are compulsory adjustments and cannot be elected around.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax – Impuesto sobre el Valor Añadido (IVA); applies in peninsular Spain and the Balearic Islands. The Canary Islands apply IGIC and Ceuta/Melilla apply IPSI instead of IVA.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EUR. Spain has no general VAT registration or de-minimis exemption threshold; VAT registration is mandatory from the first euro of taxable supplies in Spanish territory. For intra-Union distance sales of goods, the OSS scheme uses the €10,000 union-wide distance-sales threshold, but ordinary Spanish B2B and domestic B2C supplies are not subject to a registration threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Electronic invoicing is mandatory for B2B transactions in Spain under Royal Decree 1007/2023 implementing the Crea y Crece law. Invoicing software must satisfy Verifactu integrity, legibility, accessibility, and tamper-resistance requirements, and structured invoices must be in facturae/EN16931 format. Large enterprises with prior-year turnover above €6M must submit invoice records under the Suministro Inmediato de Información (SII) through AEAT HTTPS/API services within four days, constituting near-real-time clearance for that segment. There is no general AEAT digital stamping or prior-authorization requirement for ordinary exporters.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods are eligible for the export zero-rate/exemption under Article 21 of Law 37/1992 (IVA Law) when the exporter is established in Spanish customs territory, the goods are physically dispatched or transported outside the EU, and departure is evidenced by an accepted customs export declaration and transport documentation. Offshore services to a taxable person established outside the EU are outside the scope of Spanish VAT because the place of supply is at the recipient’s establishment; related input VAT remains deductible. Services directly connected with the export of tangible goods and supplied to the non-EU customer are also exempt. If the Spanish entity merely operates a marketplace and does not act as principal or deemed supplier, the underlying seller must hold the export evidence; the platform does not zero-rate goods in its own VAT return unless it has legal title to the goods or is the declared exporter.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs export declaration: Single Administrative Document (DUA/SAD) with export procedure code 10 or 20 accepted by Spanish Customs.
Transport document: Bill of Lading, Air Waybill, CMR consignment note, or rail consignment note evidencing physical departure from the EU.
Commercial invoice and packing list reflecting the agreed Incoterms and non-EU buyer.
Sales contract, purchase order, or marketplace order record evidencing the underlying B2B transaction.
Bank payment evidence: SWIFT MT103/MT202 receipt, inward remittance certificate, or marketplace settlement statement in foreign currency.
EU exit confirmation from the customs IT system (AES) or, for indirect exports, the attestation of exit from the customs office of departure.
For offshore services: contract, service report, evidence of the recipient's taxable-person status and country of establishment.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: AEAT may open an audit within the general four-year limitation period and extend the examination to all records supporting the export exemption or offshore classification. If the zero-rating is disallowed, AEAT assesses unpaid IVA, claws back any previously refunded input VAT, and imposes late-payment interest (interés de demora). Administrative penalties range from 50% to 100% of the VAT amount for failures and rise to 100%-150% for intentional concealment or false invoices. Deliberate evasion of more than €120,000 in a single tax period constitutes a criminal tax offense under Article 305 of the Criminal Code, punishable by imprisonment and fines, disqualification from subsidies, and suspension of refund rights in subsequent periods.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de España (Bank of Spain), with the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Digital Transformation as policy authority; the Dirección General de Comercio Internacional y de Inversiones (DGCI) administers foreign investment registries and declarations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Spain's euro currency is fully convertible for both current and capital account transactions under EU liberalised capital-movement rules. Profit remittances to non-residents are unrestricted, though distributions may be subject to 19% (or treaty-reduced) non-resident withholding tax. There are no exchange controls requiring authorisation for foreign-currency buying/selling or cross-border payments; however, cash flows above €50,000 per transaction mandate ex-post statistical filing to the Banco de España via its electronic declaration system.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory export-proceeds surrender or mandatory conversion ratio exists in Spain. Spanish exporting entities may freely retain foreign currency in dedicated accounts and convert at market rates. Only bank-level transaction reporting (Bank of Spain Circular 3/2020) applies to export receipts exceeding €50,000, with the importer/exporter or the bank submitting the standard E-1/E-2 statements.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium feasibility. A Spanish SL may use Spanish-authorised electronic-money institutions (EMIs) or PSD2 payment institutions (e.g., Bnext Bank or Avanza) and EEA passporting providers such as Revolut Business or Wise Business. Offshore, non-EEA EMIs lacking a Spanish/EEA licence cannot act as primary account providers; they may only operate via white-label local partnerships. Automated remote KYC is possible for local directors, but the platform's cross-border transaction volume will require enhanced due-diligence procedures and explicit contractual evidence of settlement flows.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For a Spanish SL with a Spanish-resident director and a local legal representative, the majority of tier-1 banks permit fully remote onboarding using video identification and qualified e-signature. Non-resident directors or non-EU beneficial owners generally trigger a physical or notarised interview at a bank branch or Spanish Consulate. In practice, Banco Santander, BBVA and CaixaBank require an in-person or video-notarised KYC interview for at least one director when a non-resident holding structure or multi-jurisdictional beneficial owner is present.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-frequency cross-border B2B platform transactions with diverse jurisdictional counter-parties
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Platform terms of service, seller/buyer registration database, summary of actual goods/services transactions, billing and logistics trail, and an internal compliance policy showing transaction monitoring.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership held through non-resident corporate entities or opaque structures
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified organisational diagram, certificate of good standing from the owner's registration authority, the Spanish company's share register, and sworn source-of-funds declarations for each ultimate beneficial owner.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Incoming capital inflows from jurisdictions with elevated money-laundering risk (e.g., certain Latin American or MENA sources)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Commercial invoices, signed import/export contracts, bills of lading or delivery confirmations, SWIFT purpose codes, and a written economic-substance narrative explaining the trade corridor.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Use of an offshore payment aggregator or digital wallet as an intermediary for settlement
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A licence or passport certificate of the EMI, settlement reconciliation reports covering each calendar month, proof of linkage between platform orders and bank withdrawals, and durable records of the underlying trade documentation.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Incoming equity for the Spanish SL should be wired via SWIFT MT103 using purpose code C11 (Spain's investment registry code 026) and described as 'Capital Increase' in the remittance advice. If the investor is outside the EU and the investment equals or exceeds €1,500,000, a declaration must be filed with the DGCI on Form D1A after completion; for smaller amounts, entry into the Foreign Investment Registry is still required but may be handled by the receiving bank. In all cases, the bank will require a copy of the notarial capital-increase deed, the shareholders' resolution, and source-of-funds documentation to satisfy Bank of Spain AML obligations.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Supplier and trade-counterparty settlements use SWIFT MT103 payments with reference to the invoice, purchase order, and shipping document. For high-value open-account transactions, an irrevocable commercial letter of credit (UCP600) issued by a Spanish bank and confirmed by an overseas advising bank is the standard clearing rail; presentation of transport documents, commercial invoices, and insurance certificates will trigger payment. All outgoing payments above €50,000 must be reported to the Banco de España through the bank's integrated declaration system.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Plain vanilla FX forward contracts (up to 12 months) with Banco Santander, BBVA or CaixaBank under ISDA/EMIR regulations
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for currencies with restricted onshore conversion, subject to internal counterparty credit approval
Cross-currency swaps (USD/EUR and MXN/EUR) with notional exchange at inception and maturity for long-term balance-sheet hedging
European-style FX options on major Latin American currencies evidenced by OTC ISDA confirmation and subject to EMIR margin rules
Exchange-traded currency futures (EUR/USD, EUR/MXN) listed on Euronext or CME cleared through a Spanish brokerage
FX swaps used for short-term principal and interest exchange to bridge trade-payment timing mismatches

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month after approval at shareholders' meeting; meeting must occur within six months of fiscal year-end (calendar-year entity: by July 31 immediately following year-end)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to deposit accounts triggers a filing-blocking order (hoja de la sociedad) preventing valid registration of any subsequent corporate resolutions; administrative fines from EUR 1,200 to EUR 60,000 for continuing non-compliance; risks administrative strike-off after sustained default.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate Income Tax Return (Modelo 200, Impuesto sobre Sociedades)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 25 calendar days following the six-month period after the tax year-end (calendar year: July 1–July 25).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty of 10% of tax payable plus late interest; if filed more than 12 months after the deadline, penalty increases to 20% plus late interest; failure to file may trigger non-compliance sanctions (recargo) and possible tax audit.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual UBO Declaration (Declaración de Titularidad Real)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registro Mercantil (as part of the annual accounts filing package)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Simultaneous with Annual Accounts deposit, normally July 31 for calendar-year entities.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-compliance or false statements in the UBO declaration may lead to administrative sanctions up to EUR 60,000 under anti-money laundering regulations; also triggers documentary blocks at the Registry.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory audit if, for two consecutive years at the balance sheet date, the company exceeds at least two of the following three thresholds: (a) total assets over EUR 4 million; (b) annual net turnover over EUR 8 million; (c) average annual headcount over 50 employees. Audit is also mandatory for any subsidiary within a group required to present consolidated financial statements.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Spanish GAAP (Plan General de Contabilidad) per the Spanish Commercial Code (Código de Comercio) and the General Accounting Plan; IFRS is applied by consolidated corporate groups.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The SL must file a UBO statement together with the annual accounts at the Registro Mercantil, identifying all ultimate beneficial owners. Any share transfer is valid against third parties only upon filing a notarial deed with the Registry and entry into the Register of Members; the UBO ledger must be updated within one month of any change and confirmed annually at the ordinary general meeting.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Libro Registro de Socios)
Register of Directors (Libro Registro de Órganos de Administración)

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Modelo 200 (Impuesto sobre Sociedades) via Sede Electrónica AEAT (sistema de presentación electrónica con certificado digital / Cl@ve PIN)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 25 calendar days of the 6-month anniversary of the fiscal year end (e.g., 31 December year-end → 25 July)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the Spanish NIF assigned to the non-resident-owned SL

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax period (fecha de inicio y fin del período impositivo)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: From statutory P&L audited per C.Comercio

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable base (base imponible) after prior-year loss offsets and permanent/temporary adjustments
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Maintain schedules of adjustments; apply DTA allocation only where treaty-consistent

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Integrated tax due (cuota íntegra) and tax credits (bonificaciones/deducciones)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Claim only eligible credits; non-resident shareholders cannot claim domestic employment-linked credits
Offset withholdings/advance payments; excess WHT may require Modelo 210 refund route

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing surcharge: 5% if within 3 months; 10% if within 6 months; 15% within 12 months; 20% after 12 months, plus statutory late-payment interest; separate sanctions for incorrect filings (50%–150% of the deficiency) with minimum fines for incomplete filing.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 19% (IRNR) for outbound dividends to non-residents; 0% under EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive (≥5% holding, ≥1 year) and reduced treaty rates (generally 10–15%)
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Beneficial owner must obtain a Spanish-recognised Tax Residence Certificate (TRC / certificado de residencia fiscal) and submit it to the Spanish paying agent before or at payment to apply the treaty-reduced rate; if statutory WHT has already been levied, the non-resident must file Modelo 210 (or Modelo 211 for refunds) via the AEAT electronic window within the applicable statute of limitations (4 years) attaching the TRC, audited ownership evidence and treaty entitlement forms (e.g., US Form 6166 equivalent).
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory 19% on outbound interest and royalties; 0% for EU/EEA associated companies under the Interest & Royalties Directive (25% holding for ≥2 years, subject to anti-abuse/beneficial ownership); DTA-reduced rates typically 0–10% for interest and 5–10% for royalties.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File/Master File mandatory when related-party transaction value exceeds EUR 100,000 per counterparty or EUR 250,000 in aggregate per tax period; simplified documentation available for taxpayers with net turnover below EUR 10 million.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP, Resale Price, Cost Plus, TNMM, Profit Split
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Spain applies no standalone ESR regime comparable to OECD Action 5 preferential regimes, but Articles 13 and 15 LGT (economic reality/substance-over-form), Article 15 LGT GAAR, Article 100 LGT and the ATAD-based general anti-abuse rule require a valid business motive; shell/letterbox S.L.s without local premises, employees, and management substance are recharacterizable, trigger CFC income attribution for passive income, and expose directors to veil-piercing liability.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion (Delito contra la Hacienda Pública)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Concealing revenue above EUR 120,000 per fiscal year, false invoicing, fictitious expenses, undisclosed foreign bank accounts, or profiting from the B2B platform without filing Modelo 200.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Proportional tax fine of 50%–150% of the underpaid tax (Arts. 191/195 LGT) plus late-payment interest; criminal conviction under Art. 305 Penal Code: imprisonment of 1–5 years, fine of 2–6 times the evaded amount, and loss of grants or tax advantages.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Solidary tax liability under Arts. 42.2 and 43.1 LGT for directed or consented evasion; criminal personal liability for the administrator who conceived the fraud; asset embargoes, preventive travel bans (withdrawal of passport and prohibition to leave Spanish territory), and judicial disqualification of directors.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating an S.L. with no real commercial activity, no local personnel, no premises, and purely routed payments (e.g., platform fees re-invoiced to a low-tax jurisdiction) to strip profits.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Recharacterization under Art. 13 LGT (substance-over-form) and Art. 15 LGT GAAR; application of Spanish CFC rules (Art. 100 LIS) taxing undistributed passive income; 50% late-payment surcharge plus interest; denial of treaty benefits under BEPS Action 6 (where treaty partners apply LOB/PPT) and possible mandatory disclosure reporting penalties.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Piercing the corporate veil (levantamiento del velo) in fraud or abuse cases; directors jointly liable for corporate tax debt; criminal exposure for unregistered economic activity and fraudulent insolvency where dividends were extracted without substance.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to register the real beneficial owner (titular real) in Spanish beneficial ownership registry, refusing to execute customer due diligence for B2B marketplace sellers, or processing Swift/Alibaba Pay flows without identifying counterparties.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines under Law 10/2010: minor infractions up to EUR 60,000; serious infractions from EUR 60,001 to EUR 150,000; very serious infractions from EUR 150,001 up to EUR 10 million (or triple the transaction value, whichever greater); publication of sanctions and suspension of authorization for payment service activities.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Administrators who ratified the omission risk personal fines of the same ranges; court-ordered civil restitution for laundering proceeds; travel bans under criminal anti-money-laundering proceedings (Art. 301 Penal Code: imprisonment of 3–6 years for laundering), with directors held personally liable for unlawful distributions.
